title: More Than a Penalty Kick: Brandi Chastain’s Lasting Soccer Legacy
summary:
With the men’s FIFA World Cup capturing fans around the globe, we’re revisiting our conversation with Brandi Chastain—a pioneer whose impact on soccer extends far beyond one unforgettable penalty kick.

Best known for scoring the winning penalty in the 1999 Women’s World Cup Final, Brandi shares the experiences that shaped her career—from being cut from the national team and fighting her way back to becoming one of the most influential figures in the sport. Along the way, she reflects on leadership, resilience, teamwork, and why the greatest achievements are always shared.

The conversation also explores the lasting legacy of the 1999 Women’s World Cup, the progress of women’s sports, the fight for equal opportunity, and the lessons Brandi has carried from the field into every aspect of life. Whether you’re watching this year’s World Cup or simply looking for inspiration, this episode is a timeless reminder of what it takes to change the game.
